//: Level 2 is Class 3, "unstable": every 3-6 hours on Level 2 a pipe bursts 3-6 tiles from you and floods the spot with scalding steam (the hottest hot-air field, radius 2, about 10 minutes). The shriek is loud enough to carry, so Hounds may come to look. Stepping away is the answer; standing in it brings on heatstroke fast.

effect.u_make_sound: a shriek of tearing metal and roaring steam!

effect.u_message: A pipe tears open nearby with a scream of metal, and the tunnel fills with scalding steam.  Get clear of it!
